## Stories to Numbers

| Turkish Airlines |
|---|
| The Story |
| Turkish Air is a growing company in a bad business, burning through cash with  losses, a large debt load and the government as the leading shareholder. It will continue to grow, with margins improving to global airline averages and reinvestment scaling down to reflect excess capacity. The combination of losses and high debt creates a 10% chance of failure (or bailout), where equity will be worth nothing. |
